We are looking for a PhD candidate for a project on "Advanced Analysis and Processing of Threats Using Deep Learning for System Defense" (cotutelle: IMTA, Brest - France & Polytechnique Montréal - Canada). The description of the thesis topic is attached to this email.

PhD Co-direction:
Samiha Ayed - IMT Atlantique - Brest, France Adel Abu Sitta - Polytechnique Montréal, Canada

Profile:
The candidate should have strong expertise in cybersecurity and/or machine learning/deep learning, particularly in representation learning. Proficiency in Python programming is expected, along with experience in handling complex and heterogeneous data. Knowledge related to explainability, modeling of complex relationships (temporal and causal), and dynamic systems would be considered an asset. The candidate is also expected to demonstrate scientific rigor, autonomy, strong analytical skills, and the ability to read and write scientific articles in English.

Don’t hesitate to share this with anyone who may be interested, or to contact me by email for further information or to apply.
